packageRules.description: Group non-OpenTelemetry devDependencies into one PR.

OpenTelemetry stable (api, sdk-*, resources) and experimental (exporter-*, instrumentation-*) packages MUST move together as one generation, or you get duplicate sdk-trace-base copies and type/runtime clashes. Listed last so it overrides the devDependencies rule for OTel packages. Keep the README compatibility table + package.json overrides in sync when merging this group.
